architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.note: The gateway and the worker never talk over HTTP: the queue is the only path between them.

guarantees.idempotencyDesc: The worker reads the status before acting and discards anything no longer pending. A message delivered twice cannot move money twice.
guarantees.durabilityDesc: Messages are persisted in the queue. A failed publish is found by the sweeper and republished; what fails for good lands in the dead-letter queue.

security.title: Security
security.tokensDesc: Fifteen minutes of validity and never in localStorage. The refresh token lives in an httpOnly cookie, rotated on every use.
security.reuseDesc: A refresh token used twice tears down every session for that user — that is how a stolen token becomes worthless.
security.hashingDesc: Plus CORS restricted to explicit origins, no wildcards, with per-endpoint rate limiting.
